name: rc1t
label: rare_chars
note: Token-only rare_chars detector, version 1. Online input is generated token ids only. The frozen per-corpus tables contain tokenizer features, a dev-trained 50-tree score and dev-negative reference counts; this is not a tokenizer-only or training-free detector. Ported without retuning from vllm_stability_monitor_evolution_aro_1030/deliverable_v2 (FROZEN_V2.json). One token look-ahead; intercept and monitor tiers are computed in one pass.
